summary: A 110-foot galvanized Aermotor LS-40 lookout in Lee County, South Carolina, built near 1936; its keeper's house stood until about 2010.

facts.design: Galvanized Aermotor LS-40, 110 ft, with a 7 x 7 ft steel cab

events.note: Register says built near 1936; no exact date found
Tower keeper's house on the site until about 2010; the register describes the site as abandoned

evidence.supports: 110-foot galvanized Aermotor LS-40 with 7x7 steel cab, built near 1936
evidence.quote: Built near 1936, this 110-foot galvanized Aermotor LS-40 tower features a 7'-by-7' steel cab.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources on this tower: the NHLR register entry and one Eastern US Lookouts page. Two web searches found nothing about it. Built near 1936 is approximate. Current condition, access and staffing are unverified; the standing status rests on the register wording and its October 2013 photographs. Worth asking the SC Forestry Commission.
